verdict.rationale: Unleash documents role-based access control on two levels, root and project, and Enterprise users can define custom root and project roles. Backend API tokens can be scoped to one or more projects and a single environment, and change requests add an approval gate per environment. The core story is delivered, but custom roles and RBAC appear tied to Enterprise/hosted tiers, and the evidence is short snippets. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of granular per-flag/per-environment permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration, clarity on availability outside Enterprise.
